notes.title: V. 1.2 PATCH: We're All Santa Here
notes.content:
Another February, another Christmas present, as is tradition. Here's the update!

- Added new end-credits theme
- Set default music/sound effects volume to 50% (down from 100% in the original release)
- The Santas now react if you give yourself a certain jolly name (thanks for the suggestion, Kimchi Tea!)
- Typos (corrected, not added) ((hopefully))

notes.title: V. 1.1 PATCH: Dance Time
notes.content:
Ho ho ho, merry—uh, January! I've got the traditional January present for you! It's an update for [i]Too Many Santas! [/i]Enjoy!!

- Added to our stable of creepy animations by making Sexy Santa dance
- Added an auto-text button to the bottom of the screen
- Added a quit button to the bottom of the screen
- Made a line less creepy
- Changed someone's pajamas
- Corrected various typos in both Achievements and the game (sorry, Nathaniel "Hover"!!!)
